description: This satellite image, displayed as a False Colour Composite (NIR/R/G band combination), illustrates "Bare rocks formations" (land cover class 6.3.1.1) in Anatolia, Turkey. It was captured on 2011-06-30 by a Spot 5 sensor at 2.5 m resolution. The image shows a landscape dominated by reddish-magenta areas, representing dense vegetation or forests in the Near-Infrared band. Adjacent to these are areas of greenish-cyan, indicating other vegetation types or land cover. A winding, light blue linear feature, possibly a river or a bare rocky gully, is visible towards the left. A yellow polygon line overlays part of the terrain, delineating a specific area, and the faint light blue text "9999" is visible near the linear feature. The image source is CNES 2011© Distribution Airbus D.
